items.title: Adobe Commerce文件上传需交互
items.summary_zh: 攻击者需诱导受害者访问恶意页面，上传文件可致代码执行
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级Adobe I/O Events至1.21.0并排查
items.repro_note: 需诱导用户访问恶意URL后上传文件
items.description: Adobe Commerce is affected by an Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session. Exploitation of this issue requires user interaction in that a victim must visit a maliciously crafted URL or interact with a compromised web page. Scope is changed.

items.title: Node.js Brotli解码溢出可RCE
items.summary_zh: 远程未认证攻击者提交特制Brotli流，可致内存破坏甚至RCE
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.affected: Node.js(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.repro_note: 向Brotli解压入口提交特制压缩流
items.description: A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Brotli decoder (c/dec/decode.c) in Google Brotli versions 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream. Users need to update any Brotli libraries or binaries between 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 to the latest available version: 1.0.10 or 1.1.1 or 1.2.1.

items.title: Adobe Campaign SQL注入可RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者注入SQL命令，可能以当前用户权限执行代码并控制账户
items.affected: Adobe(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级Adobe Campaign Classic至修复版
items.repro_note: 经ACC输入点注入SQL，需定位接口参数
items.impact_scope: 营销平台后台，含敏感数据
items.description: Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) is affected by an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary SQL commands, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.

items.title: EPICS Base整数溢出可RCE
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者发送特制网络请求，可致内存破坏、DoS或潜在RCE
items.repro_note: 构造特制网络请求触发整数溢出
items.impact_scope: 工业控制系统基础库，网络可达
items.description: In EPICS Base release 7.0.10 and prior, an integer overflow in network request processing can cause memory to be allocated with an incorrect size. Subsequent handling of attacker supplied data may result in memory corruption, denial of service, or potential remote code execution.

items.title: MLflow评分器反序列化RCE
items.summary_zh: 调用者可上传恶意模块并经scorer/invoke加载，执行任意代码
items.repro_note: 经artifact上传模块并调用scorer/invoke加载
items.description: From 3.12.0rc0 until 3.17.0, third-party scorer deserialization in mlflow/genai/scorers/base.py accepts request-selected descendants of THIRD_PARTY_SCORER_ALLOWED_MODULES rather than requiring an exact allowed module. A caller can use MLflow artifact endpoints to place a Python module beneath a writable allowed package and submit its module and class through /ajax-api/3.0/mlflow/scorer/invoke.
